Title: HTTP Client
Description: Send HTTP requests from your Windows machine through a local companion, with no account or MyDevTools proxy.
Seo_Title: HTTP Client for Windows — No Account or Cloud Proxy | MyDevTools
Keywords: HTTP client, REST client, API tester, Windows HTTP client, local API client, no account
PrivacyShort: Requests go directly from your Windows machine to the target
SetupIntro: Download and launch the Windows local companion required by this tool, then return to this page.
InstallAgent: About the Windows companion and download
SetupStep2: Launch MyDevTools Agent; its icon appears in the Windows system tray.
SetupStep3: Open the agent window from the tray icon and copy the displayed pairing code.
SetupStep4: Enter the code below. If the browser asks for local-network access, allow it for this connection.
LimitsNote: Requests accept up to 1 MiB bodies, responses up to 16 MiB, and timeouts up to 120 seconds.
PrivateSetupNote: Private, loopback and LAN targets are blocked by default. Restart the companion with --allow-private only when you intentionally need them. Pairing adds http.request and keeps capabilities already granted in this browser; it never grants a scanner.
PrivacyNote: The browser sends request details only to the companion on 127.0.0.1. The companion connects directly to the target; target URLs, headers and bodies can therefore leave your machine. MyDevTools servers do not receive or proxy them. Request drafts, including URLs, headers and secrets, and bodies are saved automatically in this browser; responses are not saved. The connection token is stored separately for up to 8 hours or until the agent restarts; the pairing code is not stored. Once the agent offers encrypted storage, drafts move there and are removed from the browser.

Seo_Introduction: Send HTTP and HTTPS requests without creating an account or routing API credentials through a MyDevTools server. A small companion running on your Windows computer performs the network request and returns status, timing, headers and the response body to this page.
Seo_DetailedDescription: The browser pairs explicitly with the companion on `127.0.0.1` using a short-lived one-time code. It stores the resulting session token in this browser for up to 8 hours or until the agent restarts; the code is not stored. The token grants only the `http.request` capability. Requests go from the companion directly to the target. Public targets are allowed by default; private, loopback and LAN addresses require the deliberate `--allow-private` startup option. Redirects are off by default and sensitive headers are removed when a redirect changes origin. Request drafts, including URLs, headers and secrets, and bodies are saved automatically in this browser so they reopen later; responses are not saved. The connection token is stored separately for up to 8 hours or until the agent restarts. With a current agent, drafts are kept encrypted on the computer by the agent instead of the browser.
Seo_Examples: Use **GET** to inspect a JSON endpoint, **POST** with `Content-Type: application/json` to test an API payload, or **HEAD** to inspect response metadata without a body. Add `Authorization: Bearer …` only when the target API requires it; it is sent to that target, not to MyDevTools servers.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Install and start the companion
Download the Windows x64 companion and launch it.

### Step 2: Pair explicitly
Request a code in the companion window, enter it here and click **Connect**. The code is cleared immediately after the attempt.

### Step 3: Compose the request
Choose a method, enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL, then add optional headers and a raw UTF-8 body.

### Step 4: Send and inspect
Send the request to view native status, timing, final URL, duplicate-preserving headers and a safe text preview. Download binary bodies byte-for-byte.
Seo_Tips:
- Keep redirects off when you need to inspect the first response.
- Credentials in an `Authorization` header go to the target service; avoid sharing screenshots that contain them.
- Leave private-network access disabled unless you deliberately test a trusted LAN service.
- Pairing this tool never authorizes future port or network scanning capabilities.

SecretsHint: Values stay in the agent's encrypted vault and never come back to the page. Put {placeholder} into the URL, a header or the body: the agent substitutes it only for the listed hosts and hides it in the response.
SecretValueKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored value.
SecretHostsHint: Comma-separated: api.example.com, *.example.com for subdomains, 127.0.0.1. No scheme, port or path.
SecretDeleteConfirm: Delete secret {name}? Requests that use it will stop working.
SecretNameInvalid: Name: up to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
SecretNameTaken: A secret with this name already exists. Use Edit to change it.
SecretValueInvalid: Enter a value up to 8 KiB without line breaks or control characters.
SecretHostsInvalid: List 1–16 hosts like api.example.com or *.example.com, without scheme, port or path.
AuthHint: Fields accept {{variables}}. A write-only secret goes in as {{secret:name}} for Basic, Bearer, API key and the OAuth client secret. AWS keys must be variables: this page computes the signature.
AuthInheritNone: No folder above sets auth, so the request is sent without it.
AuthInheritParent: «Inherit from folder» takes the parent folder's auth; at the top level it means no auth.
AuthTokenReady: Token received, valid until {time}. It is kept only on this page.
AuthTokenReadyNoExpiry: Token received. It is kept only on this page.
EnvironmentsHint: Use {{name}} in the URL, params, headers, body and auth. The active environment overrides folder variables, and those override globals. For a write-only value, set the variable to {{secret:name}}.
FolderVariablesHint: Available as {{name}} to every request in this folder and its subfolders; a nearer folder wins.
UnresolvedVariables: Variables not set: {names}. They are sent as written.
ErrorAuthIncomplete: Fill in the required auth fields.
ErrorAwsSecret: AWS Signature is computed on this page, so its keys, URL, headers and body cannot use {{secret:…}}. Use a variable instead.
ErrorOAuthToken: Could not get an OAuth token: {detail}
Error_vault_unavailable: The agent's encrypted storage is unavailable.
Error_vault_key_unavailable: The agent cannot unlock its storage key for this Windows user.
Error_vault_corrupt: Stored data failed its integrity check and was not changed.
Error_vault_full: The agent's storage limit is reached.
Error_not_found: Not found in the agent's storage.
Error_secret_not_found: A {{secret:…}} placeholder names a secret that does not exist.
Error_secret_host_denied: A secret used in this request is not allowed for this host.
BodyNoneHint: The request is sent without a body.
BodyFormHint: Checked rows are sent as key=value pairs with Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded unless an enabled header overrides it. Keys and values accept {{variables}}.
BodyMultipartHint: Each checked row is a text field or a file. Content-Type multipart/form-data with its boundary is set automatically and replaces one set by hand.
BodyFilesHint: Files stay in this page's memory only: after a reload, choose them again. Variables are not substituted inside files.
BodyBinaryHint: The file is sent as is. Content-Type is the file's type unless an enabled header overrides it.
GraphqlHint: Sent as JSON {"query", "variables"} with Content-Type application/json. Both fields accept {{variables}}.
ErrorFileMissing: Choose the file “{name}” again: files are not kept after a reload.
ErrorGraphqlVariables: GraphQL variables must be a JSON object.
ImportCurlHint: Paste a curl command, for example from the browser's DevTools «Copy as cURL» (bash or cmd). A new request is created; a command pasted into the URL field replaces the open request instead.
CurlIgnored: Skipped options the client does not repeat: {options}.
CurlFiles: Choose these files on the Body tab: {files}.
CurlErrorNotCurl: This is not a curl command: it must start with curl.
CurlErrorNoUrl: The curl command has no URL.
CurlErrorQuote: The curl command has an unclosed quote.
CodeHint: Built from the open request: variables are substituted, {{secret:…}} stays a placeholder, files are referenced by name. An AWS signature and an OAuth token are valid for a limited time.
